experiment: Sixteen full-scale, simple-span cold-formed 9x3 C-purlin supported roof assemblies (four purlin lines, through-fastened 26 gage panels) were loaded to failure in a vacuum chamber under simulated gravity (7 tests) and simulated uplift (9 tests), with measured cross-section dimensions, tensile coupon properties and AISI constrained-bending predicted loads reported for comparison.
title: Simple Span Cold-Formed C-Purlin Supported Roof System Tests

variables.definition: Test designation number identifying each of the sixteen roof-system tests, repeated across all tables.
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7; Table 2.1 p.18; Table 2.2 p.20; Tables 3.1/3.2 pp.26-27; Table 3.3 p.36; Table S1
variables.name: Test number
variables.note: Test 13 is printed as '13 **'; one Table 3.3 row is labelled 'Ext E'.

variables.definition: Which of the two interior test purlins (East or West) the measured dimensions, computed properties or coupon came from.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.18; Table 2.2 p.20; Table 3.3 p.36
variables.name: Purlin location (East/West)
variables.note: Printed only once per pair in the original; repeated in the CSV.

variables.definition: Direction of the simulated loading applied by the vacuum chamber (gravity for Tests 1-6 and 16, uplift for Tests 7-15).
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 side heading p.7; Table S1 column load_direction
variables.name: Loading direction

variables.definition: Nominal sheet gage number of the test purlin material (14 gage except Test 5 at 12 gage and Test 6 at 16 gage).
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7; Table S1 column nominal_gage; note to Table 2.1
variables.name: Nominal purlin gage

variables.definition: Relative orientation of the flanges of the two interior test purlins (same, facing or opposing), defined by sketches at the bottom of Table 1.1.
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7; Table S1 column purlin_orientation
variables.name: Purlin orientation

variables.definition: Whether shear clips were used to connect the purlins to the rafters (Yes/No).
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7
variables.name: Shear clips used
variables.note: Test 1 purlins were bolted directly to the rafters with no shear clips.

variables.definition: Whether torsional restraint braces were installed at the rafter supports.
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7
variables.name: Torsional restraint at rafters

variables.definition: Location/spacing of intermediate lateral braces along the span (none, at midspan, at ends and midspan, etc.), summarized in Table S1 together with the purlin-to-rafter connection arrangement.
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7; Table S1 column bracing
variables.name: Intermediate bracing arrangement

variables.definition: Free-text configuration notes printed in the remarks column of the test matrix and of the results tables (bracing locations, orientation, fastener behavior).
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7; Tables 3.1/3.2 pp.26-27
variables.name: Configuration remarks
variables.note: Ditto marks (") mean same as the row above.

variables.definition: Simple-span length of the purlins between supports, 25 ft 0 in. for all tests except Tests 15 and 16 (24 ft 8 in.).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column span_ft; header note to Table 1.1 p.7 and to Table 2.2 p.20
variables.name: Span length
variables.note: Given as a note in Tables 1.1 and 2.2, as a column in Table S1.

variables.definition: Number of spans in the test assembly; 1 (simple span) for every test.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column n_spans
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in each test assembly (four: two interior 9x3 C test purlins and two edge 7x3 C purlins).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column n_purlin_lines and header note
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Spacing of the purlin lines, 5 ft 0 in. on center, giving a 5 ft tributary width per purlin.
variables.evidence: Header note to Table S1: 'Purlins were spaced 5 ft. 0 in. on center (tributary width 5 ft.)'
variables.name: Purlin spacing
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Cold-formed cross-section shape of the interior test purlins (C-section with lipped flanges).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column section_type
variables.name: Cross-section type

variables.definition: Type of roof panel/attachment system: nominally 26 gage through-fastened panels 2 ft 6 in. by 15 ft, attached with No. 12 x 1 in. self-drilling fasteners at 15 3/4 in. o.c.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column panel_type and header note on panels and fasteners
variables.name: Roof panel/attachment type
variables.note: Panel gage, size and fastener spacing are given only in the header note.

variables.definition: Overall measured depth of the C-purlin cross-section (9.00 in. nominal), measured on each interior test purlin.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.18 column total_depth_in; Table S1 column depth_in
variables.name: Purlin depth

variables.definition: Measured material (base metal) thickness of the test purlin, taken from the cross-section measurements and repeated in the strength summary.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.18 column thickness_in; Table S1 column thickness_in
variables.name: Purlin thickness
variables.note: Table S1 sometimes gives an average of the two purlins (e.g. 0.0755).

variables.definition: Width of the top (W1) and bottom (W2) flanges measured from the outside of the web to the tangent of the corner radius.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.18 columns w1_in and w2_in (defined in Figure 2.1)
variables.name: Flange widths (top, bottom)
variables.note: Two columns for the two flanges of the same section.

variables.definition: Length of the top (T1) and bottom (T2) edge stiffener lips from the free end to the tangent of the radius.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.18 columns t1_in and t2_in (defined in Figure 2.1)
variables.name: Lip lengths (top, bottom)

variables.definition: Inside bend radius between lip and flange at the top (R1) and bottom (R4) of the section.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.18 columns r1_in and r4_in (defined in Figure 2.1)
variables.name: Lip-to-flange inside radii

variables.definition: Inside bend radius between flange and web at the top (R2) and bottom (R3) of the section.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.18 columns r2_in and r3_in (defined in Figure 2.1)
variables.name: Flange-to-web inside radii

variables.definition: Measured angle between the lip and its flange at the top (theta1) and bottom (theta2) of the section.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.18 columns theta1_deg and theta2_deg (defined in Figure 2.1)
variables.name: Lip-to-flange angles

variables.definition: Gross moment of inertia of the purlin cross-section about the horizontal bending axis, computed from the measured dimensions.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column i_gross_in4
variables.name: Gross moment of inertia

variables.definition: Gross section moduli referred to the top and bottom extreme fibers, computed from the measured cross-section.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 columns s_t_gross_in3 and s_b_gross_in3
variables.name: Gross section moduli (top, bottom)

variables.definition: Effective moment of inertia used for strength computations, from the AISI effective-width analysis of the measured section.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column i_strength_in4
variables.name: Effective moment of inertia (strength)
variables.note: One cell printed with an unreadable character ('13.3[?]2').

variables.definition: Effective section moduli referred to top and bottom fibers from the AISI effective-width (strength) analysis.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 columns s_t_strength_in3 and s_b_strength_in3
variables.name: Effective section moduli (strength)
variables.note: The bottom-fiber column is printed under the heading S_t.

variables.definition: Effective flange width BE from the AISI effective-width analysis, printed in the column headed S_e.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column s_e_in3
variables.name: Effective flange width
variables.note: Column heading S_e but values are a width in inches.

variables.definition: Allowable compression stress used in the AISI analysis of the purlin section.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column f_c_ksi
variables.name: Allowable compression stress
variables.note: Based on assumed Fy = 56 ksi.

variables.definition: Allowable tension stress used in the AISI analysis of the purlin section.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column f_t_ksi
variables.name: Allowable tension stress

variables.definition: Allowable bending stress for the web from the AISI analysis.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column f_bw_ksi
variables.name: Allowable web bending stress

variables.definition: Allowable moment of the purlin governed by the compression flange, from the AISI analysis.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column m_c_ftk
variables.name: Allowable moment, compression flange

variables.definition: Allowable moment of the purlin governed by the tension flange, from the AISI analysis.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column m_t_ftk
variables.name: Allowable moment, tension flange

variables.definition: Allowable moment of the purlin governed by the web, from the AISI analysis.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column m_w_ftk
variables.name: Allowable moment, web
variables.note: One cell printed as '8.14[?]'.

variables.definition: Governing AISI allowable moment multiplied by the factor of safety (printed heading 1.65, printouts 1.67) to give the predicted ultimate moment capacity.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column m_u_ftk
variables.name: Predicted ultimate moment
variables.note: Test 3 East value printed as 13.084, which the appendix printout gives as 13.439.

variables.definition: Predicted uniform failure load per purlin line corresponding to the AISI constrained-bending moment capacity with the factor of safety removed, computed for the test span.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column w_u_plf; Table 3.1 p.26 and Table 3.2 p.27 column p_pred_plf; Table S1 column aisi_predicted_load_plf
variables.name: AISI predicted failure load
variables.note: Several Table 2.2 cells contain unreadable digits; the report does not state which purlin's w_u the single tabulated prediction corresponds to.

variables.definition: Moment of inertia used for the deflection calculations of the purlin.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column i_defl_in4
variables.name: Deflection moment of inertia

variables.definition: Computed midspan deflection of the purlin per 100 plf of applied uniform load for the test span.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.20 column delta_per_100_in
variables.name: Deflection per 100 plf
variables.note: Some cells printed with unreadable digits.

variables.definition: Yield stress of 56 ksi assumed in the AISI section-property and predicted-load calculations.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 description p.20 and Table S1 header note on AISI predicted loads
variables.name: Assumed yield stress
variables.note: A stated assumption, not a column; measured average was 54.0 ksi.

variables.definition: Factor of safety of 1.67 (printed as 1.65 in one column group heading) removed from the AISI allowable moment to obtain the reference capacity.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 column group heading '(1.65*allowable)' p.20; Table S1 header note
variables.name: Factor of safety removed
variables.note: Inconsistently printed as 1.65 and 1.67.

variables.definition: Measured ultimate (failure) uniform load per purlin line, equal to the applied vacuum load plus the dead load carried by a test purlin.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 p.26 and Table 3.2 p.27 column p_test_plf; Table S1 column failure_load_as_printed
variables.name: Measured failure load
variables.note: Test 13 result is declared invalid by the authors.

variables.definition: Dead load supported by a test purlin that is added to the applied vacuum load to obtain the reported failure load (e.g. 8.9 plf in Test 1).
variables.evidence: Header note to Table S1 and note to Tables 3.1/3.2
variables.name: Dead load per purlin
variables.note: Given only by example in a note.

variables.definition: Ratio of the measured failure load to the AISI constrained-bending predicted load, printed in parentheses beneath the actual failure load.
variables.evidence: Tables 3.1 p.26 and 3.2 p.27 column p_test_over_p_pred; Table S1 column actual_to_predicted_ratio
variables.name: Test-to-predicted load ratio
variables.note: Printed with parentheses in Tables 3.1/3.2.

variables.definition: Description of the observed failure (e.g. local buckling of the compression flange and/or web of a test purlin, fastener pull-out) recorded at the ultimate load.
variables.evidence: Tables 3.1 p.26 and 3.2 p.27 column failure_mode; Table S1 column failure_mode
variables.name: Observed failure mode
variables.note: Ditto marks in the printed tables mean same as the row above.

variables.definition: Measured thickness of the standard tensile coupon cut from the test purlin.
variables.evidence: Table 3.3 p.36 column thickness_in
variables.name: Coupon thickness
variables.note: Test 13 East printed as '0.07[?]'.

variables.definition: Measured width of the reduced section of the tensile coupon.
variables.evidence: Table 3.3 p.36 column width_in
variables.name: Coupon width

variables.definition: Yield stress of the purlin steel measured in standard tensile coupon tests, reported per coupon and carried to the summary table per east/west purlin; average of 32 coupons was 54.0 ksi.
variables.evidence: Table 3.3 p.36 column fy_ksi; Table S1 columns yield_stress_east_ksi and yield_stress_west_ksi
variables.name: Measured yield stress
variables.note: Test 14 West printed with an illegible last digit ('55.2[?]'); Test 10 West printed as '.57.87'.

variables.definition: Ultimate tensile stress of the purlin steel measured in the standard tensile coupon tests.
variables.evidence: Table 3.3 p.36 column fu_ksi
variables.name: Measured ultimate tensile stress
variables.note: Last row of the table is the average of 32 coupons.

variables.definition: Elongation at fracture measured on the tensile coupons.
variables.evidence: Table 3.3 p.36 column elongation_pct
variables.name: Coupon elongation

variables.definition: Source table and PDF page numbers from which each summary row's failure load and related values were taken.
variables.evidence: Table S1 columns value_source and pages
variables.name: Value source and pages
variables.note: Provenance metadata, not a physical quantity.
